description: Everything in the captured output outside debug sections, as written: directive names, directives with their arguments' shapes, section directives, mnemonics with their prefixes, operand shapes, instruction forms, label shapes and comments. Each entry counts its lines and lists the cases containing it, as each program's optimization levels. Shapes replace numbers with N, numeric label references with Nf or Nb, symbols with sym (.L symbols with .Lsym), strings with "…" and registers with their class (r64, r32, r16, r8, xmm, mm, st, st(i) as written, rip, segment registers by name); a token written against `[` or after `FLAT:` is a symbol whatever its spelling, and so is every name in a directive. GCC's spacing is kept. `debugSectionDirectives` counts the directives inside debug sections. Nothing here is classified.
